text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She managed to leave a good result in the 
Japan Cup. But... Neo Universe mentioned 
that previously, she was in 4th place, and 
1st place went to Tap Dance City.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A shocking truth is then revealed. Neo 
Universe cannot see the future. She sees 
herself across alternate universes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Neo Universe in the other universe 
suffered a crushing defeat, finishing 10th 
at the "GATE"—the Tenno Sho (Spring). And 
after that, she vanished.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To prevent her disappearance, the next 
race will be— the Osaka Hai, just as 
chosen in the other universe. Here, they 
must achieve an even better result.
